Holistic care is critical to heart health and should include a review of other lifestyle habits that can contribute to 
cardiovascular disease. For example, smoking cessation is extremely important, as nicotine constricts blood vessels 
and reduces blood flow while increasing blood pressure (Srakocic, 2023). 
Physical activity is also paramount when reducing cardiovascular risks. Exercise helps with weight control, BMI, and 
waistline management, and reduces the risk for diabetes. Regular physical activity can also help manage stress and 
improve mood (Harvard University, 2023).
